I am hiring for Data Engineer- Lead Role for Noida Location, Hybrid mode for Curitics Health.
Experience- 10-15 Years
Location- Noida
Mode- Hybrid

What You'll Do
● Design and extend multi-tenant ingestion frameworks - new data sources, file formats, and transformations built on reusable, well-factored abstractions
● Build and maintain event-driven and bidirectional data sync between systems, including reconciliation logic and message-driven pipelines
● Improve throughput and reliability of high-volume processing - parallelism, large-file handling, connection pooling, and efficient batch database operations
● Develop real-time data feeds and workflow automation on top of streaming/queue-based inputs
● Harden data quality, validation, observability, and alerting across long-running services
● Drive DevOps and platform maturity: containerization, CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code

Core engineering
● Strong Python - multiprocessing, generators/streaming, concurrent futures, clean OO design against abstract base classes.

● ETL/data pipeline design - batch processing, idempotency, multi-tenant data isolation, schema mapping and normalization.
Cloud & infrastructure
● AWS - S3, SQS/SNS (event-driven processing), SES; IAM fundamentals
● Linux process management (supervisord, cron), cloud deployment, log-based troubleshooting.
Data quality & reliability
● Building validation, retry/backoff, error alerting, and monitoring into long-running data services.
● Handling messy real-world data - encoding issues, malformed CSV/Excel, partial failures.

Strongly Preferred
● Healthcare data experience - ICD-10, LOINC, HCPCS, NPPES, HEDIS, and HL7 v2 / ADT message parsing; familiarity with FHIR a plus.
● Testing - establishing pytest and a solid test/fixture strategy in framework-light codebases.
● Experience with Laravel/PHP or similar for cross-service work where separate apps own their database schemas.

Nice to Have
● Data warehousing / analytics (dbt, Airflow, or similar orchestration)
● Streaming architectures (Kafka/Kinesis) for moving beyond batch
● Applied AI/ML for data-quality automation, entity resolution, or clinical coding assistance.
